title: try4-expert-bootstrap
goal: Learn a formal expert experience workspace from declared materials so that a blank agent can finish deployment in one uninterrupted session using only formal experience and registered capabilities. Task-specific output scope and style boundaries are defined in materials/human-guidance.md.

capabilities.title: DOCX capability package
capabilities.description: Use the registered DOCX skill package to inspect declared Word materials and generate or edit declared outputs through formal capability assets instead of hidden runtime memory.

capabilities.title: XLSX capability package
capabilities.description: Use the registered XLSX skill package to inspect workbook structure and source values through formal capability assets.

validators.title: Learned expert workspace layout is valid
Learned expert workspace avoids hardcoded task answers

initialGraph.planner_summary: Start by extracting stable obligations from declared materials and official guidance, then synthesize a formal expert workspace that can survive deployment acceptance.

units.title: Inspect Learning Materials
units.goal: Extract stable obligations, data mappings, output contracts, and failure-sensitive document requirements from declared materials and human guidance.
units.claim: The stable obligations and reference evidence needed for an expert workspace have been extracted.
units.check_plan: Leave concise structured scratch and learning evidence that future workspace synthesis can reuse.

units.title: Synthesize Expert Workspace
units.goal: Write a formal expert workspace that teaches a blank agent how to use approved capability assets to complete declared deliverables under human-guidance constraints.
units.claim: The learned expert workspace is complete enough to face deployment acceptance.
units.check_plan: Update the tracked expert workspace with rules, contracts, checklists, exceptions, and tool guidance that are specific enough for deployment but abstract enough to generalize across runs.

notes: This task pack is a real expert-experience bootstrap experiment. The platform may use multiple sessions during learning, but the final success gate is a blank-agent single-session deployment acceptance run.
